blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea — North Korea fired two short-range ballistic missiles into the sea off its eastern coast on Sunday, South Korea’s military said. The second missile flew more than 600 kilometers (370 miles). The launches came days after Pyongyang reasserted its status as a nuclear-armed state and rejected a United Nations resolution demanding that it halt its nuclear activities.
